answer: A new identity earns its place by holding a mountain summit: one solar relay per peak, verified by triangulation from three valley stations. Hourly the registry pings the relay; the crystal oscillator inside stamps the reply with its unique drift, and the echo round-trip time must match that summit's exact distance, so a reply from anywhere else fails. A second identity needs its own summit, relay, and climb: $520 hardware plus $160 guided ascent, $680 per fake. Fielding 5,000 clones takes 5,000 peaks, $3.4 million, and 5,000 separate climbs; no wholesaler can sell one summit twice.
